title: NAS security mode control initiation by the network

entities.name: NAS Security Mode Control Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to establish NAS security context. Involves sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message and starting timer T3460.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE to initiate security mode control procedure. Contains security algorithms, key set identifier, and replayed UE security capabilities.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to MME to confirm successful security mode control procedure. May include IMEISV or UE radio capability ID when requested.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to MME to indicate security mode control procedure failure.

entities.name: T3460
entities.description: Timer started by MME when sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND. Stopped upon receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE or SECURITY MODE REJECT.

entities.name: NAS Key Set Identifier
entities.description: IE containing key set identifier and type of security context flag (native or mapped security context).

entities.name: Security Capabilities
entities.description: Replayed UE security capabilities including NAS, RRC and UP ciphering and integrity capabilities.

entities.name: UE Additional Security Capability
entities.description: Additional security capabilities of UE included when supported by MME and provided by UE.

entities.name: HASHMME
entities.description: Hash value calculated by MME from plain ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message when received without integrity protection.

entities.name: Emergency Attach Procedure
entities.description: Condition when security mode control is initiated during attach procedure for emergency bearer services with no shared EPS security context.

entities.name: TAU with GPRS Ciphering Key Sequence Number
entities.description: Condition when security mode control is initiated upon receipt of TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST with GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE.

entities.name: Locally Generated KASME
entities.description: Property where MME and UE create locally generated KASME when security mode control is initiated under specific emergency conditions.

entities.name: Downlink NAS COUNT Reset
entities.description: Property where MME resets downlink NAS COUNT counter and uses it to integrity protect initial SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.

relations.description: Security mode control procedure includes sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Procedure starts timer T3460 when sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND.
Receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE stops timer T3460.
Receiving SECURITY MODE REJECT stops timer T3460.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains NAS Key Set Identifier IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains replayed UE security capabilities.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains UE additional security capabilities when supported.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND contains HASHMME when ATTACH REQUEST or TAU REQUEST is received without integrity protection.
Emergency attach condition establishes creation of locally generated KASME.
TAU with GPRS ciphering key sequence number condition establishes downlink NAS COUNT reset.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND requires integrity protection using reset downlink NAS COUNT.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND may be sent unciphered but integrity protected when using locally generated KASME.
